runs.model: YOLOv8 - car parts (2 variants: with / without side mirrors)
runs.notes: Powers photo → part detection on Siteauto (utils/detect.py, inference confidence floor 0.15). Training details weren't recorded in the repo. The with/without-mirror variants exist because mirrors changed what the model saw.

runs.training: LoRA rank 8, alpha 16, dropout 0.05, lr 2e-4, batch 4 × 4 grad accum (defaults)
runs.notes: Defaults come from LLM Finetuner's config/default_settings.json. Training runs fully locally behind the web UI with live GPU metrics.
License-plate detection pipeline in Detectie: YOLO finds the plate, GLM-OCR reads the text, results stream over WebSocket to an ESP32 client.
